sentences.fixed: We eat fruit because it is healthy for us.

vocab.def: A large formal meal for many people, usually to celebrate something special.
vocab.simple: A banquet is a big fancy dinner party with lots of food and many guests!
nonex: It does NOT mean a small meal for one person.
It does NOT mean fast food.
vocab.example: The school had a banquet at the end of the year with music and lots of food.
vocab.starter: If I could plan a banquet, I would serve _______ ...
vocab.why: A banquet is a great word for a big celebration meal that brings many people together!

vocab.def: To scatter small drops or tiny pieces of something over a surface.
vocab.simple: Sprinkle means to drop tiny bits of something on top, like sugar on cookies!
nonex: It does NOT mean to pour a lot of something.
It does NOT mean to mix things together.
vocab.example: We like to sprinkle cinnamon on top of our oatmeal every morning.
vocab.starter: I like to sprinkle _______ on my _______ ...
vocab.why: Sprinkle is a useful cooking word for adding a little bit of something on top of food!

vocab.def: To add pretty things to something to make it look nicer or more festive.
vocab.simple: Decorate means to make something look pretty by adding colors, ribbons, or fun things to it!
nonex: It does NOT mean to break something.
It does NOT mean to clean something.
vocab.example: We helped decorate the classroom with balloons and streamers for the party.
vocab.starter: I like to decorate _______ with _______ ...
vocab.why: Decorating is a fun way to make places and things look festive for celebrations!

vocab.def: A special event or time when something important or fun happens.
vocab.simple: An occasion is a special time when something exciting happens, like a birthday or holiday!
nonex: It does NOT mean a regular school day.
It does NOT mean something boring.
vocab.example: Grandma's 80th birthday was a very special occasion for our whole family.
vocab.starter: A special occasion I remember is _______ ...
vocab.why: Knowing the word occasion helps you talk about important and happy events in your life!
